settings_currency_desc: Choose the primary currency used for prices, expenses, proceeds, and financial balances across the app.
quicksetup_currency_desc: Currency used to track hardware purchases and sales.
network_diagnostics_desc: On-demand ICMP Echo test to measure RTT, line instability (jitter), and packet loss.
startup_apps_desc: Monitoring of apps registered for automatic startup (HKCU, HKLM, and WOW6432Node).
startup_modal_notice: PC Tracker does not directly modify startup keys to preserve system stability. Use official Windows settings to manage startup programs.
windows_update_reboot_pending: System restart required to finalize updates
windows_update_reboot_pending_desc: Patches or protected system files are waiting for a computer restart to take effect.
health_finding_reboot_pending_title: System restart required to finalize updates
health_finding_reboot_pending_explanatio: One or more security updates or system servicing components (CBS / Windows Update) have been installed and require a system reboot to complete safely.
health_finding_startup_apps_high_title: High number of applications configured for automatic startup
health_finding_startup_apps_high_explana: A large number of processes loaded at boot can significantly increase startup times and initial memory and CPU resource usage.
opt_finalize_windows_update_title: Finalize System Updates with a Scheduled Restart
opt_finalize_windows_update_reason: One or more system updates or patches have been downloaded and installed, but require a PC restart to consolidate into the kernel and system DLLs.
opt_finalize_windows_update_benefit: Completes the application of security patches and ensures the stability and consistency of protected system files.
opt_finalize_windows_update_action: Controlled restart of the operating system after finishing current work sessions
opt_review_startup_apps_title: Review Applications with Automatic Startup Enabled
opt_review_startup_apps_reason: A large number of applications start automatically when the PC powers on, increasing boot times and consuming RAM and background CPU cycles.
opt_review_startup_apps_benefit: Significant reduction in PC boot time and freeing memory and processor resources for primary applications.
opt_review_startup_apps_action: Opening the native Windows Startup Apps interface to selectively disable non-essential items
startup_modal_empty: No applications found with the current filters.
windows_update_desc: Detection of pending restarts post-updates, CBS servicing state, and file renames.
health_finding_display_limited_title: High refresh rate monitor running at only {currentHz} Hz ({monitor})
health_finding_display_limited_explanati: Display {monitor} supports up to {maxHz} Hz but is currently set to {currentHz} Hz in Windows display settings.
health_finding_display_mixed_rates_title: Multi-monitor setup with mismatched refresh rates
health_finding_display_mixed_rates_expla: Connected displays run at different refresh rates. In multi-screen scenarios, this can sometimes lead to micro-stuttering or desktop window manager desync.
health_finding_audio_service_stopped_exp: The Windows audio service is currently stopped. No games or applications can output audio until the service is restarted.
health_finding_audio_sample_rate_degrade: Audio sample rate reduced or suboptimal
The default audio endpoint is set to a sample rate below 44.1 kHz, degrading audio fidelity and potentially causing aliasing.
health_finding_audio_issues_title: Anomalies detected in audio subsystem or drivers
health_finding_audio_issues_explanation: The Windows audio engine reports warnings or degraded device status.
opt_display_maximize_refresh_rate_title: Unlock Maximum Monitor Refresh Rate ({maxHz} Hz)
opt_display_maximize_refresh_rate_reason: Monitor {monitor} supports up to {maxHz} Hz but is capped at {currentHz} Hz in Windows settings.
opt_display_maximize_refresh_rate_benefi: Maximum visual smoothness, instantaneous cursor response, and reduced input lag in games and desktop tasks.
opt_display_maximize_refresh_rate_action: Open Windows Advanced Display Settings to configure the highest refresh rate
opt_audio_format_review_reason: The current audio setup is suboptimal or requires verification to ensure maximum fidelity and low latency.
opt_audio_format_review_benefit: Higher audio quality, broader dynamic range, and elimination of unnecessary software resampling.
care_display_hub_desc: Hardware detection of connected monitors, native resolution, supported refresh rates, and DPI scaling.
care_audio_hub_desc: Monitoring active audio endpoints, sample rate (Hz), bit depth, and system audio service status.
health_finding_ethernet_link_downgraded_: Ethernet link negotiation degraded to {speed} Mbps (cable or port issue)
Network adapter {adapter} is negotiating at only {speed} Mbps instead of full Gigabit/Multi-Gig speed. Check the integrity of the 8 pins in your CAT5e/CAT6 Ethernet cable or router/switch port.
health_finding_wifi_weak_signal_title: Weak Wi-Fi signal: quality at {percent}% (risk of instability and jitter)
health_finding_wifi_weak_signal_explanat: Connection to wireless network "{ssid}" has degraded signal strength ({percent}%, {rssi} dBm). This can cause packet loss, micro-disconnections, and fluctuating latency in online gaming.
opt_network_verify_cable_title: Inspect Ethernet Cable & Switch Port ({nominal} Mbps)
opt_network_verify_cable_reason: The physical link is negotiating at only {speed} Mbps instead of nominal {nominal} Mbps. This is commonly caused by bent pairs, damaged RJ45 connectors, or 4-wire limited cables.
opt_network_verify_cable_benefit: Restores full link bandwidth up to {nominal} Mbps (10x faster) and eliminates LAN/Internet download bottlenecks.
opt_network_verify_cable_action: Replace the Ethernet cable with a certified CAT6/CAT6A cable or reconnect to a Gigabit/2.5G router port
opt_network_wifi_reception_reason: Received Wi-Fi signal is sub-optimal ({percent}%, {rssi} dBm). Physical obstructions, misaligned motherboard antennas, or crowded channels degrade throughput and increase ping.
opt_network_wifi_reception_benefit: Higher wireless connection stability, zero packet loss, and consistent low-jitter latency.
opt_network_wifi_reception_action: Ensure rear chassis Wi-Fi antennas are firmly screwed in and positioned upright, or reduce distance to the router
care_network_hub_desc: Active adapter hardware detection, link speed negotiation (Mbps), wireless metrics, and IP addresses.
care_export_report_desc: Export the full PC diagnostic health summary including scores, sensors, hardware inventory, and optimizations.
care_export_report_success: Care Center health report exported successfully!
